exposure: Combined advanced maternal and paternal age
cohort: The study included 8,863 nulliparous pregnancies from the nuMoM2b prospective cohort where both maternal and paternal age at conception were known.
finding: Advanced paternal age alone was not significantly associated with maternal or fetal/neonatal adverse outcomes, in contrast to advanced maternal age and pregnancies with both parents of advanced age, which were associated with significantly increased risk.
